title: Launcher focused runs of a declared TRX test command judge pass/fail from exit code and record no TRX counts
outcome: When `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- <command>` wraps a command that termal-tests.toml declares with a TRX artifact, the launcher's focused stage records the test counts (passed, failed, skipped) and the verdict from that artifact under the declared-artifact rules, not from the process exit code alone; or the host refuses the run with a named reason that points at the declared route.
acceptance: A behavioral regression runs the launcher's focused mode over a declared command whose real TRX reports a pass and one whose TRX reports a failure (including a failing TRX with exit 0), and shows results.json records tests counts from the TRX and the verdict follows the TRX rules of docs/features/declared-test-commands.md; an undeclared command keeps today's behaviour.
docs/test.md describes how a focused run of a declared command is judged.
